text: The full-message setup now registers capture/once listeners for load and MsgLoaded regardless of readyState. Document load calls the extracted display helper and reveals the chosen message; message completion applies the in-conversation header class, messageId and minimum height. Initial display and switching messages both insert a new browser before setup. This removes the branch that skipped both listeners when readyState was complete. It does not replay prior events, add URL filtering or prove rendered timing and dimensions. No message or UI test ran.
title: Conversation view always registers its two full-message callbacks
